notes: Wave director resolves formation id + count into off-screen spawn points. All offsets in world px relative to player at event fire. Prefer spawn outside camera frustum (~half viewport + margin).

scatter.description: Random annulus around player. Default trash.

ring.description: Full surround. First horde + fly chaos + dense packs.

cross.description: N/E/S/W arms. Spitter teaching + elite packs.

line.description: Side dump. Hounds and elite plated drifters.

flood_from_edge.description: Lane/edge dump. Dog hordes and ambient pressure.

center.description: Boss spawn near player mid-screen, then pattern owns space.
